title: Documentation alignment plus system and profile workflow updates
summary: Aligned developer docs with the repo layout, API runtime envelope, and frontend JavaScript structure. API_AUTH and API_CONTRACT were synced with standardized envelope behavior and explicit auth error codes. System navigation and configuration were extended with a new Operational page and API endpoint, plus role/capability controls for operational access. Profile workflows were updated with Date of Invitation and Field Personnel integration (role-driven dropdown), plus contact number validation and list-column cleanup. Seeder/truncator scripts were reset for a fresh workflow (retain only seed_grievance_options and add a new full reset truncator), and sidebar UX was improved with vertical scrolling for long active menus.
